title: ProjectProfile
description: iTestAgent Project Profile — deterministic + inferred facts about an iOS project. Source: architecture design doc §6.1 + data-flow doc §5. Stored at ~/.itestagent/projects/<project-hash>/project-profile.json

projectHash.description: sha256(workspace path + git head). Deterministic identifier.

app.description: App identity. Deterministic fields from xcodebuild / XcodeProj.

features.description: Inferred feature candidates. Must carry evidence + confidence (R4: core paths are never auto-finalized).

suggestedSmoke.description: Suggested smoke test entry points. Inferred, requires user TUI confirmation.

hasXCUITest.description: Whether project contains XCUITest targets. Determines execution path (A: xcodebuild test / B: DeviceBackend explore).

hasScheme.description: Whether a test scheme is configured.

CandidateLink.description: Inferred feature. MUST include evidence + confidence (R4).

requiresAccount.description: Whether feature requires user account (affects test data strategy).

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0. <0.5 should be flagged as low-confidence in TUI.

confirmed.description: Whether the user has confirmed this candidate in the TUI (AC3: only confirmed links enter TestPlan/Flow). Default false.

displayOrder.description: User-controlled display ordering; lower = higher priority. Default 0 (insertion order).

expectedOutcomes.description: Profile-inferred expected outcomes for this feature (US-11.1 AC1 tier 2). Each string describes an expected result, e.g. 'home screen should appear'. Used by AssertionEvaluator as tier-2 assertions when no user assertions exist.
